newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Seven to participate in Brazil's Banerj auction.
newsitem.headline: Seven to participate in Brazil's Banerj auction.

text.p: Seven financial institutions have prequalified to participate in the privatization of Rio de Janeiro's state bank Banco do Estado do Rio de Janeiro (Banerj), an official said.

Brazil's Bradesco, Itau and Companhia de Investimentos Latino Americana, France's CCF, Austria's BBA Creditanstalt, GE Capital Corp and Bank of Boston of the United States have prequalified, according to Paulo Ferraz, the president of private investment bank Bozano, Simonsen.
Bozano, Simonsen has been administering Banerj since January this year with the aim of cleaning up its books ahead of privatization.
The same seven institutions, plus health insurance company Golden Cross, also prequalified for the privatization of Banerj's insurance subsidiary, Banerj Seguros, Ferraz said.
He said it had yet to be decided whether Banerj and Banerj Seguros would be sold off separately or as a unit.
Ferraz said the date for the auction of Banerj was not yet set, but the bank would definitely be sold before the end of the year.
He said the tender document was ready and would be published as soon as the state and federal government settled their accounts with Banerj.
-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151
